mapper.select: SELECT O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_TYPE, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.TOTAL_PRICE, O.DISCOUNT_AMT, O.CREATED_AT, O.USER_ID, O.USER_COUPON_ID, MIN(P.PRODUCT_NAME) AS productName, COUNT(OI.ITEM_ID) AS itemCount FROM ORDERS O LEFT JOIN ORDER_ITEM OI ON O.ORDER_ID = OI.ORDER_ID LEFT JOIN PRODUCT P ON OI.PRODUCT_ID = P.PRODUCT_ID WHERE O.USER_ID = #{userId} GROUP BY O.ORDER_ID, O.ORDER_TYPE, O.ORDER_STATUS, O.TOTAL_PRICE, O.DISCOUNT_AMT, O.CREATED_AT, O.USER_ID, O.USER_COUPON_ID ORDER BY O.CREATED_AT DESC
SELECT ORDER_ID, ORDER_TYPE, ORDER_STATUS, TOTAL_PRICE, DISCOUNT_AMT, CREATED_AT, USER_ID, USER_COUPON_ID FROM ORDERS WHERE ORDER_ID = #{orderId} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
